entries.what: One Call API 2.5 at /data/2.5/onecall is closed. The page gives June 2024 with no day, so diedOn is that month's last day. It names neither the URL nor an error code. Other /2.5/ APIs are not affected.

source.quote: access to One Call API 2.5 has been finally closed in June 2024

requires: One Call API 3.0 has its own subscription, which requires card details, and API keys can take several minutes to activate.
